premise: Berry Bush shakes down berries for everyone who comes by — Ankylosaurus, then Glider, who lands in his leaves; when the friends want to give something back, Bush says he needs nothing, but Glider knows: Bush is ticklish, and a good tickle is the best present of all. (Bush offers; nobody takes.)
inspiration: Grimm's 'Mother Holle' (the apple tree that asks to be shaken), turned: the tree is the giver, and the friends find the one gift it wants.
lesson: Friends give back, even to someone who never asks.

en-US.title: Berry Bush Shares
en-US.text: {bush:enter} Berry Bush had more berries than anyone, shiny red ones and round purple ones. {bush:face happy} And he loved to share. {ankylosaurus:enter} "Hungry, Ankylosaurus?" he called. {ankylosaurus:go to bush} {bush:live shake} He gave himself a good shake, and down dropped a handful of berries. {ankylosaurus:live munch} {sfx:munch} Munch, munch. {ankylosaurus:face happy} "Thank you, Bush!" Then {glider:enter} Glider came gliding down {glider:go on bush} and landed right in his leaves. "Berries for you too!" Glider nibbled and nibbled, until his whiskers were purple. {glider:live groom} Then he washed his face, rub, rub, rub. [giggles] {bush:face surprised} "Hee hee!" Berry Bush wriggled. "Your little paws tickle!" {ankylosaurus:pulse} "What can we give you, Bush?" asked Ankylosaurus. "You give us berries every day." Berry Bush thought. Bushes don't eat berries. {bush:face happy} "I don't need a thing," he said. {glider:face happy} But Glider knew. [playfully] He scampered through the leaves, {sfx:rustle} tickle, tickle, tickle, {bush:live rustle} and Berry Bush rustled and giggled from top to bottom. {ankylosaurus:live laugh} Ankylosaurus laughed too. [happily] {all:face happy} "That," giggled Berry Bush, "is the best present of all."

es-ES.title: Arbusto lo comparte todo
es-ES.text: {bush:enter} Arbusto de bayas tenía más bayas que nadie: rojas y brillantes, moradas y redondas. {bush:face happy} Y le encantaba compartirlas. {ankylosaurus:enter} —¿Tienes hambre, Anquilosaurio? —le llamó. {ankylosaurus:go to bush} {bush:live shake} Se sacudió bien fuerte y cayó un montón de bayas. {ankylosaurus:live munch} {sfx:munch} Ñam, ñam. {ankylosaurus:face happy} —¡Gracias, Arbusto! Luego llegó {glider:enter} Planeador, planeando, {glider:go on bush} y aterrizó entre sus hojas. —¡Para ti también! Planeador mordisqueó y mordisqueó, hasta que se le pusieron los bigotes morados. {glider:live groom} Luego se lavó la cara, frota que te frota. [giggles] {bush:face surprised} —¡Ji, ji! —Arbusto se retorció—. ¡Tus patitas me hacen cosquillas! {ankylosaurus:pulse} —¿Y qué te podemos dar nosotros, Arbusto? —preguntó Anquilosaurio—. Tú nos das bayas todos los días. Arbusto se quedó pensando. Los arbustos no comen bayas. {bush:face happy} —No necesito nada —dijo. {glider:face happy} Pero Planeador lo sabía. [playfully] Correteó entre las hojas, {sfx:rustle} cosquillas por aquí, cosquillas por allá, {bush:live rustle} y Arbusto se sacudió de risa de arriba abajo. {ankylosaurus:live laugh} Anquilosaurio también se rio. [happily] {all:face happy} —Este —dijo Arbusto entre risitas— es el mejor regalo de todos.

munch.prompt: a sturdy animal munching juicy berries, soft squishy chewing, realistic, close
